name: Oberalp Group
desc: Family-owned Bolzano group that owns mountain-sport brands Salewa, Dynafit, Pomoca, Wild Country, Evolv and LaMunt and distributes partner sports brands.
products: Mountaineering, ski-touring and climbing equipment and apparel; distribution of Under Armour, Fischer, Falke, Bollé and others
customers: Sports retailers and dealers in 60+ countries; consumers
marketing_autonomy_basis: Independent family group with its own brand marketing teams (press page lists brand marketing directors)
markets: Europe-led, dealers in over 60 countries worldwide for its mountain brands
qualifying_metric: Route C: employees and international distribution
fit_rationale: Owns several outdoor brands and an exclusive distribution business; F1 could lift Salewa or Dynafit awareness in Europe and Asia, but its outdoor-sport audience overlaps only partly with F1.
f1_markets: Italy, Austria, Germany-adjacent Alpine markets, Spain, UK, USA, Japan

access.roles: Group CEO; brand Marketing Director (Dynafit International lists a Marketing Director); Group Corporate Communication & PR Manager

outstanding: Group revenue not found on its site; no dated 2025-26 signals found on press page

name: Bodyfriend
desc: Seoul maker of massage chairs and AI 'healthcare robots', founded in 2007 and selling in Korea, the United States and Europe.
products: Massage chairs, healthcare robots, medical R&D-led wellness devices
customers: Consumers; hospitals, hotels and companies including Cedars-Sinai, Caesars Palace and Citadel (per its global page)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Stand-alone brand owner with its own ambassadors and lounges
stores_or_sites: 6 company-run stores in California; Paris base for Europe
markets: South Korea, United States (California stores), France and European dealers
expansion_markets: Europe via major massage-chair dealers; exhibited at IFA 2024
qualifying_metric: Route C: international operations and named enterprise customers

alt_indicators.evidence: Korea HQ, six direct stores in California, Paris base for Europe
Premium chairs supplied to Cedars-Sinai, Next-Health, Caesars Palace, Citadel

fit_rationale: Premium massage-chair and recovery-robot brand building presence in the US and Europe; driver-recovery storytelling and paddock-lounge product placement suit F1, and it already uses sports ambassadors.
